ministry: Department of Women Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
benefits_summary: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 for unmarried girls aged 13-18 in school (K1) and a one-time grant of ₹25,000 upon turning 18 if continuing education or vocational training (K2).
exclusions: Families with annual income exceeding ₹1,20,000 (waived for physically challenged or orphaned girls)
application_steps: Obtain the K1 or K2 application form from the Head of your Educational Institution.
Submit the completed form along with birth, income, and unmarried certificates to your school/college.
Track application status on the official Kanyashree portal (wbkanyashree.gov.in).
